added.member: og style art: a dress cell lists several selectors
added.summary: A slot's `dress` cell in art-requests.json may be a list of the dressings it goes to alike (`["Panel.frame", "Dialog.panel"]`): the painted cell is packed once and each dressing gets its slice and tone, so a pack's window art dresses its dialogs and its field art its select and stepper without a copied slice going stale when the atlas is packed again.
